summary: Recorded receipt 2da98141144a4133a3cd1873be786862, the rerun of the phantom restart probe in which both events share the case label phantom_restart and the commit half is marked by a phase field. This time the declared prerequisite correlated: the commit half shows the failed AddVoter, a latest configuration index of 3 over a log ending at 2, three phantom voters and a command committed at index 4 while the committed peer stayed at 2; the restart half shows servers A and B only, two voters, the new server absent, the last stored index still 4 and a stored commit index of zero. The comparison asserting that the restarted node does not load the new server was therefore evaluated and holds, so the process-local reading of the phantom configuration now rests on a decided comparison rather than on unreviewed events. The limitation that recorded the uncorrelated comparison is removed and replaced with one stating that the pair is still a single scenario, with the committed peer partitioned and no snapshot, so later restarts and a second failed change after restart remain untested. The joint history notes that this run repeats the earlier experiment from new inputs differing only in the shared case label and the added phase field, and both phantom knowledge entries gain the receipt.
